Reconstructed all 105 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions use the same stanza breaks, inferred from the verse structure. I rendered the ambiguous “Abad Wallah Maninsa Hussain” as `ابد واللہ ما ننسى حسین`.

Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. Only the selected Markdown file changed, and `git diff --check` passed.
